_comment: TODO: replace every device_id below with the real ROM id from `ls /sys/bus/w1/devices` on the Pi (all three buses show up together in this one directory - see edge/DEPLOY.md for why). All 15 device_id values below are IDENTICAL PLACEHOLDERS - DS18B20s have no address pins, so wire and read one probe at a time, label it, and fill in its unique ROM id here before moving to the next. Leaving duplicates in place will make every probe read the same value.
_comment_buses: 3 independent 1-Wire buses, not 1 - so a probe shorted by acid takes out only its own 5, not all 15. 'bus' below is descriptive only (for diagnostics/logging - see edge/mockgen.py's RealOneWirePoller and test_real_pollers.py, which group results by it); the actual read always works by ROM id regardless of which bus a probe is physically on, since Linux exposes all three buses under the same /sys/bus/w1/devices directory.
